scope: Independent local file hashes, actual PCM16 numeric checks, source preservation and cue inventory. No browser, native playback, loudness perception, human approval, game installation or paid requests.

signalSummary.lfProxyMeaning: 180 Hz one-pole low-pass energy, circularly warmed; not a brick-wall spectral integral. Source rumble cleanup can reduce total LF proxy even when a small bass layer is added.

checks.note: The local decoded intermediate is independently measured; numeric source metrics alone are insufficient for this check.

checks.meaning: Checks actual waveform change beyond uniform level; not a perceptual timbre judgment.
Added layer energy only; this does not certify perceived bass balance.

comparison.note: Raw RMS ratio includes source normalization and duration differences. Peak-matched RMS is a numeric comparison, not perceived loudness.

addedBass.denominator: mean channel energy after safe-level normalization/highpass; before final shared gain
